Name: Lisha Alchemy Home
Author: Akatsuki718
Description:
在秘密森林深处，结识炼金师莉夏，探访她的草药小院与炼金工坊。完成委托、研究配方、体验好感剧情，逐步解锁配方，制作药剂、体验特殊转化、装备强化和工匠保星。模组包含四季场景、高清人物与立绘，以及莉夏的小镇日常和姜岛度假，为山谷生活增添一位朋友和一段炼金之旅。

Deep in the Secret Woods, meet Lisha the alchemist — visit her herb courtyard and alchemy workshop. Complete her requests, research recipes, and enjoy friendship events as you gradually unlock your recipes: brew potions, try special transmutations, upgrade your equipment, and preserve artisan stars. The mod includes four-season scenes, HD character art and portraits, Lisha's daily life in town, and her Ginger Island holiday — adding a new friend and an alchemical journey to valley life.
[b]Language:[/b] the in-game text of this mod is in [b]Simplified Chinese[/b]. No English localization is included at this time.
[b]
Features[/b]
[list]
[*]35 alchemy recipes, unlocked through requests, research and experience[/*]
[*]Five friendship events (2 / 4 / 6 / 8 / 10 hearts) with choices[/*]
[*]Portable alchemy bench, recipe research menu and special transmutation[/*]
[*]Equipment reinforcement, artisan star preservation and the Philosopher's Stone[/*]
[*]Monthly town outings, festival appearances and a Ginger Island holiday[/*]
[*]Desert Festival stall with rotating stock (beginner / intermediate potions, advanced items, Philosopher's Stone, Teleport Crystal)[/*]
[*]Four-season scenes, HD portraits/sprites and a searchable scene lookup[/*]
[/list][b]AI Usage Disclosure[/b] This mod was developed with the help of generative AI tools.
[list]
[*][b]AI-Generated Content[/b] — HD character portraits and artwork were produced with generative AI tools.[/*]
[*][b]AI Media[/b] — the mod page cover and promotional images were produced with generative AI tools.[/*]
[*][b]AI Assisted[/b] — code and writing were developed with substantial AI assistance.[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements / Installation[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6, SMAPI 4.1.10+, Content Patcher 2.9.0+[/*]
[*]Unzip, put the whole 
[code]Lisha Alchemy Home[/code] folder into your Mods folder[/*]
[*]The folder must contain both 
[code][CP] Lisha Alchemy Home[/code] and 
[code]Lisha Alchemy Home Runtime[/code][/*]
[/list]
